t: The One Sport Dolce&Gabbana cologne - a fragrance for men 2012
s: One of it's kind, especially that it is a sport fragrance. I truly don't understand the comments saying it is poor in performance. Totally not my experience at all. If i spray more than 3 sprays I'll still be able to smell them on my clothes for a couple of days. Maybe the commenters have different batches or that it has been reformulated. I have to give it a sniff next time i pass by a perfume shop. My final thoughts Projection 6.5 Longevity 8 Scent 7 Would also recommend blind buying this, it's a safe sporty fragrance.
